mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a pleasant 67 degrees out at Badger Prairie County Park, with the third quarter moon still lingering.
The City of Verona is offering a rain barrel rebate to encourage water conservation, and residents can also purchase cemetery plots at 565 North Main Street if needed.
There is plenty to do around town with Hop Haus Trivia today, followed by the Downtown Farmer's Market and Yoga at Insight Wellness happening tomorrow.
In our weekly report, on July 31st, an officer performed a traffic stop that resulted in the arrest of a driver for an O W I and suspended vehicle registration.
Today's flavor of the day is Butter Pecan. Culver's is currently closed, but they will open at 10 AM today. Tomorrow's flavor is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie.
